hey_mycroft.ipa: h eɪ m aɪ k ɹ ɔ f t

description: WakePhoneHuBERT phone posteriors matched against the phones of 'hey mycroft'. No recordings and no training for the phrase.
notes: Phones 'h eɪ m aɪ k ɹ ɔ f t' written by hand, because espeak-ng reads the name with the vowel of 'mick'. Threshold, confirm_blocks and debounce are the plugin defaults.
